paragraphs: Kale Logistics Solutions sells community platforms that connect the parties at a cargo gateway on one system, an Airport Cargo Community System for airports and a Port Community System for sea ports. The port platform is described as connecting terminals, vessels, port authorities, customs, government entities, truckers, freight forwarders and customs brokers on one platform. Other products listed on the products page cover terminal ground handling, customs filing, freight forwarding, rail orders, air waybills, delivery orders and certificates of origin.

The products page addresses buyers who manage a national trade gateway or a single freight forwarding branch. For Cargo Community Systems the page states that costs are recovered through a nominal transaction fee rather than an upfront investment by the customer. The airport page names Mumbai International Airport and Bengaluru International Airport as places where the system runs. The port page names Port Klang in Malaysia and VOC Tuticorin Port in India.
